services.name: Waverunner Rentals
services.desc: Rates Starting at $69 About >Located in beautiful Madeira Beach and Treasure Island, Florida at John's Pass, there is no easier way to rent a waverunner. Less than a minute from the Gulf of Mexico, you board your waverunner from the safety of our dock in the calm waters of the pass. Watch the dolphins and manatee play as you taxi a very short distance to the Gulf of Mexico, where you can open that throttle up and really enjoy the power of our newer Yamaha models. We keep our equipment in top running condition with a dedication to your enjoyment. All prepared by a knowledgeable staff with a willingness to please. Available Times >7 Days a Week > - 9:00am - 7:00pm >Call to book our rentals

services.name: Fishing Charters
services.desc: Located in Johns Pass Village and Boardwalk in Madeira Beach, Fl. where you can find some of the best fishing that Florida has to offer. Explore the Gulf of Mexico with your family and friends on our 32 ft center console SeaVee, powered by brand new 2019 400hp Mercury motors, and top of the line Simrad electronics. Our boat is designed to get you to our spots, and hooked up in no time. All anglers are welcome! Whether professional or novice we will meet your fishing expectations. FISH ON! Everything is provided including bait, tackle, rods, reels, ice, fishing licenses, and filleting of your fish! Bring only what you want to eat and drink for the day. quotes.text: We just rented three jet skis for 2 adults, 2 teens and 2 kids. What a great time!! Well organized and informative. Had a clean bathroom and multiple lockers to keep our things. Jet skis were in excellent condition and easy to use. We recommend to anyone of any age!!

The BEST place on John’s Pass to go jet skiing. We have come here time and time again and every time it’s better than the last. The staff are extremely friendly and helpful and go the extra mile to ensure you have the most enjoyable time! I cant wait to come back!
